name: recall
description: Reconstruct your recent working context from your own chat history, live state, and the shared record (user reports, prior fixes, incidents), then hand back a tight current-state brief. Use for past sessions, earlier days, and other session ids: 'recall my work on X', 'what have I been working on', 'where did I leave off', 'what did I work on', '上次我们做到哪了', '这周做了什么', '之前的会话', '过去几天', before starting or resuming work. Do not use for this conversation's own recap: 'catch me up on this conversation', 'summarize this chat', '总结一下这次对话' are ketchup, not recall.
